project_type: Full-stack cricket auction platform: Next.js 14 (React + TypeScript) + NestJS monorepo + PostgreSQL (Neon) + Socket.IO + AWS S3
build_system: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo + esbuild for backend, Next.js for frontend
test_framework: Vitest for unit/integration tests, Playwright for E2E (to be configured)
verification_instructions: 1. Build with pnpm run build — all packages compile. 2. Run tests with pnpm run test — all tests pass. 3. Schema lint with prisma validate. 4. Type check with tsc --noEmit. 5. For database: create migrations with prisma migrate dev --name <name>, test with npm run test:db
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma schema compiles to packages/database/node_modules/.prisma/client. Contracts are hand-authored TypeScript, never generated. Database migrations in packages/database/prisma/migrations/.
environment_constraints: DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL env vars required for database operations (Neon non-pooled and pooled). Cognito keys and S3 credentials in separate env files. No hardcoded PSL teams or eight-team assumptions.
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md: Backend authority for auction state, bids, timers, purse, permissions. Use PostgreSQL + Prisma with FKs, transactions, normalized schema. Clear module boundaries. Real-time events authenticated and room-scoped. Financial correctness: BigInt for money, purse ledger, immutable history. File safety: validate logos, use S3 with least privilege. Host subscription required. No client-authoritative values.
key_patterns: Modules: users (identity) → teams (team identity) → players (player master data) → new: subscriptions (host entitlements), rooms/tournaments (auction container), team-allocation (member assignment). Contract files in packages/contracts/src. Shared types in packages/database/prisma. API endpoints validate Cognito JWT, map to internal User. Frontend Next.js routes. Service layer handles domain logic, isolated from HTTP/Socket.IO handlers. Prisma transactions for financial operations.
relevant_files: packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma (extend with SubscriptionPlan, Subscription, RoomSettings, RoomAccessPolicy, AuctionTeam versioning, RoomMember)
apps/api/src/modules: auth, users, teams, players → new: subscriptions, rooms, invitations, team-allocation
apps/web/src/app/(dashboard): new auction entry and browse, room creation wizard, subscription status
apps/api/src/common: auth guard, request validation, error codes
directory_structure: apps/api/src/modules/ — NestJS modular backend, one module per domain. apps/web/src/app/ — Next.js route groups: (auth), (dashboard), auction, etc. packages/contracts/src/ — TypeScript DTO/contract files, shared by frontend and API. packages/database/prisma/ — Prisma schema and migrations.
